'''Excarga''' was a mining [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The planet had ties to the [[Mining Guild/Legends|Mining Guild]].

Excarga was the site of the [[Battle of Excarga|First]] and [[Battle of Excarga|Second Battles of Excarga]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]; in the former, the planet was captured by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]; in the latter, liberated by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
===Galactic Republic===
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], just a few weeks after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] initiated an [[Battle of Excarga|attack]] on the planet after learning of the valuable ore located there. The C.I.S. attack on Excarga was successful and they imprisoned the planet's population.<ref name="BFC">''[[Boba Fett: Crossfire]]''</ref> However their victory was short lived when [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces on the planet defeated the rising droid armies during the [[Battle of Excarga|Second Battle of Excarga]].<ref name="BFC" /> As the C.I.S. fleet fled the planet a Republic fleet under the command of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] attempted to destroy any [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|droid transports]] before they could escape into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="CWA">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>

===Galactic Empire===
The planet later fell under the influence of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and was represented in [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] by [[Drextar Pym]]. The ore-producing world for the most part managed to stay far from the front lines during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], while it secretly suppled the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] with materials.<ref name="J7">{{JournalCite|7|A Taste of Adventure}}</ref> However, an unknown battle between the Rebel Alliance and the Galactic Empire occurred here sometime during the Galactic Civil War between [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Excarga became an active member of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="J7" />

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The planet was first mentioned in the [[1995]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure "[[Countdown to Disaster]]" from [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 7|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 7]], where it was spelled "Exarga."<ref name="Countdown to Disaster">{{JournalCite|7|Countdown to Disaster}}</ref> The [[1998]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' corrected the spelling to Excarga,<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> but the misspelling occurred again in [[2002]] with the article "Mining Guild to Fine Exarga" in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 52|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #52'']].<ref name="Holonet">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|52|business/13418_2.html|Mining Guild to Fine Exarga}}</ref>
